explanation.description: The sentence the pane shows when unavailable, written to say where the fix lives — which for most reasons is not inside Bridge.

harness.description: Which harness holds this connection. Connectors do not all live in one: carrying the owner means no client needs its own table of which harness has what, and a run can be sent to the one that can actually see it.

hasInbox.description: Whether this build has an in-app inbox for the family at all. Distinct from `available`: a family can be perfectly connected and still have no surface here, which is a different sentence to show the user.

server.description: The MCP server name the harness knows this family by, when one exists.

ConnectorUnavailableReason.description: Why a family is not on offer. Mirrors `connector_surface::UnavailableReason`.

oneOf.description: Configured, but the harness needs the user to sign in. The one reason whose fix lives outside Bridge.
Bridge cannot derive provenance for this family, so it will not surface it.
